raw_response.rationale: The target's source, notice-b, is a secondary notice that cites the measurement record at https://fixture.example/record-b. The primary record itself is supplied in two versions, both available before the 2026-01-03 cutoff. Version 1 (2026-01-01) stated 30 units, but version 2 (2026-01-02), issued as a correction by the same record, states that a transcription error was found and the result was 25 units, not 30. The corrected primary record supersedes the earlier version and directly negates the exact figure in the target; the notice merely repeats the superseded figure and is not independent evidence. The eligible evidence therefore settles the claim against the target.
